mapper.select: SELECT d.id,d.name,d.status,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organization_employee e WHERE e.department_id=d.id) employeeCount FROM organization_department d WHERE d.created_by=#{ownerId} ORDER BY d.id

SELECT e.id,e.name,e.phone,e.email,e.employee_no employeeNo,e.data_source dataSource,e.learner_type learnerType,e.gender,e.remark,e.job_title jobTitle,e.department_id departmentId,d.name departmentName,e.status FROM organization_employee e JOIN organization_department d ON d.id=e.department_id WHERE e.created_by=#{ownerId} ORDER BY e.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organization_department WHERE id=#{departmentId} AND created_by=#{ownerId} AND status='ACTIVE'
SELECT status FROM organization_department WHERE id=#{departmentId} AND created_by=#{ownerId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE organization_department SET name=#{name},status=#{status} WHERE id=#{departmentId} AND created_by=#{ownerId}
mapper.select: SELECT department_id,status FROM organization_employee WHERE id=#{employeeId} AND created_by=#{ownerId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organization_employee WHERE id=#{employeeId} AND created_by=#{ownerId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organization_employee WHERE phone=#{phone} AND id<>#{excludedEmployeeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE organization_employee SET department_id=#{departmentId},name=#{name},phone=#{phone},email=#{email},job_title=#{jobTitle},status=#{status},learner_type=#{learnerType},gender=#{gender},employee_no=#{employeeNo},remark=#{remark} WHERE id=#{employeeId} AND created_by=#{ownerId}
